title: geometry/mesh sub-packages: data/ (49 files) split into representation, bundle, analysis, rings, patches; paths into geodesic/query/spline; load -> io; crossfield -> fields; quadlayout records -> model
description:
Repo plan phase 1.5 (pure moves, names unchanged). geometry/mesh/data has 49 top-level files mixing core data, algorithms and a CLI. Target (see the plan section 2, geometry/mesh table):
- representation: + MeshTopology, QuadMeshTopologyHelper, HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData (from graphics/render/model; removes geometry -> graphics).
- ops: + MeshScale, MeshVertexOffset.
- io: renamed from data/load.
- bundle: GeometryBundle and slots (GeometryBundles, EdgeMarks, RingBundle, CornerUvField, CornerUvSplit, MaterialData, MaterialSet, SlotCarry).
- analysis/segmentation (SemanticPatchDecomposer, MorseSmale*, DiscreteGradient*, MeshSegmenter, BoundarySnap, PatchBoundaryWalker, Patch, PatchDecomposition), analysis/skeleton, analysis/curvature (PrincipalDirectionField, CrestLineDetector, SaddlePointDetector, LimbAxis).
- rings: RingCandidateExtractor, RingCandidates, RingRegions, RingRegionExtraction, BranchCrossSectionRing, RegionExplosion, SurfaceRing, AuthoredSplineRing, RingAttachment, RingSegmentMode.
- patches: BezierFit, Coons*, CharrotGregoryPatchSampler.
- paths/geodesic, paths/query (+ SurfaceFaceLocator from graphics/render/model), paths/spline.
- fields/crossfield from quadlayout/crossfield.
- quadlayout/*/records -> quadlayout/*/model (the packages hold no Java records).
- PatchDecomposerCLI and the CLI main in MeshSkeletonExtractor go with the devtools ticket.
Coordinate with open worktrees: this touches many imports; land it quickly and sync others after.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. geometry/mesh/data has no top-level classes except those the ticket lists as staying, with a reason.
2. Behaviour is unchanged: the unit suite passes, every scene in CanvasSceneMap still launches, and the generated registries (MeshNodeRegistry, SceneRegistry, CommandRegistry, AutomationRouteRegistry) and automation_routes.json list the same ids as master. Moved packages carry their package-info.java, and ARCHITECTURE.md is regenerated by SpliceArchitectureDoc. No class is renamed.
3. Quad-suite and ring fingerprints byte-identical to master.
4. Launch entry and screenshot.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test.
2. Fingerprints before and after on the quad suite and the crawfish ring DSL.
unknowns: REFACTOR-PLAN-2.md's 'no nested classes, records or enums' rule: still current? It decides whether records -> model is the right name. Ask the user if not ruled by the time this starts.
changes-made:
Moves only, no class renamed, no logic touched (109 classes, 439 files rewritten by a scripted import pass). Under geometry/mesh/data: representation += MeshTopology, QuadMeshTopologyHelper, EdgeKey, TriangleGeometry, HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData (from graphics/render/model); ops += MeshScale, MeshVertexOffset; load -> io; bundle = GeometryBundle(s), EdgeMarks, RingBundle, CornerUvField, CornerUvSplit, MaterialData, MaterialSet, CurveGeometry, SlotCarry (from ops); analysis = MeshDistance; analysis/segmentation = SemanticPatchDecomposer, MorseSmale*, MscCellAssembly, DiscreteGradient*, MeshSegmenter, BoundarySnap, PatchBoundaryWalker, Patch, PatchDecomposition, PatchColors; analysis/skeleton = MeshSkeletonExtractor, MeshSkeletonComparator; analysis/curvature = PrincipalDirectionField, CrestLineDetector, SaddlePointDetector, LimbAxis; rings = RingCandidateExtractor, RingCandidates, RingRegions, RingRegionExtraction, BranchCrossSectionRing, RegionExplosion, SurfaceRing, AuthoredSplineRing, RingAttachment, RingSegmentMode; patches = BezierFit, Coons*, CharrotGregoryPatch(Sampler); paths/geodesic, paths/query (+ SurfaceFaceLocator, TriangleBvh), paths/spline; fields/crossfield (+constraint) from quadlayout/crossfield; quadlayout/{embedding,motorcycle}/records -> model. data/ keeps only PatchDecomposerCLI (developer tool; leaves with the devtools ticket). New package-info for every new package; ARCHITECTURE.md regenerated by the compile. Not done here: RingTool.snapToWall into paths/query (a method extraction, not a move). Note: SurfaceFaceLocator.appendSegments takes a graphics LineSet, so geometry -> graphics.render.model remains through that one class (HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData's edge is gone).
Verification: mvn test 521 run, 0 failures. Generated Scene/MeshNode/Command/AutomationRoute/Geometry registries list the same ids as the eng-20 base (only cross_field's factory FQN changed); mesh-node-catalog.json and automation_routes.json byte-identical. All 21 CanvasSceneMap scenes launch headless with a screenshot (tmp/scenes/). Ring fingerprints (ui-state, crawfish_rings.dsl 82 rings + fertility_rings.dsl 13) identical before/after (tmp/rings-before.txt vs rings-after.txt). Quad suite eng-20 (tmp/quad-suite/mesh-58-before) vs mesh-58 (mesh-58-after): 14/14 MATCH, signature and screenshot sha256 identical (pipeline-incomplete status is the base's missing stage log lines). Launch entry 'MESH-58: ring-tool' (crawfish_rings fixture).
